description.value: Port Hardy Visitor Centre is a year-round tourism information office on the waterfront of Hardy Bay, staffed by professional visitor services personnel who help travellers plan trips across the North Island region. Port Hardy sits at the northern end of Vancouver Island and is the departure point for the BC Ferries Northern Expedition route to Prince Rupert, making it a natural waypoint for touring cyclists heading up-island or connecting to the mainland. The centre offers local knowledge on transportation, accommodation, attractions, and day trips.

address.value: 7250 Market Street, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the visitor centre at 7250 Market Street, Port Hardy, with phone (250)-949-7622 and email. It is described as open year-round with seasonal hours. The site is a tourism information office providing travel planning assistance for the North Island region. No evidence was found on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any of the optional amenities. OSM had no phone; the website supplies one. A temporary January relocation to the Port Hardy Museum is noted on the website.
